observed_report: Owner reports framebuffer fragmentation beneath the retired 9.50 dove spinner.

observations.original_format: PNG indexed palette + binary tRNS transparency
observations.legacy_save_and_temp_buffers: gDC::setSpinner allocates HD/FHD buffers using gPixmap automatic allocation.
observations.frame_buffer_size_comes_from: Native loader passes the first PNG dimensions to gDC::setSpinner.

candidate.format: Truecolor RGBA PNG, no palette or tRNS
candidate.buffer_allocation: Below the reviewed stock acceleration threshold; CPU-backed frame, save and temp surfaces.
candidate.native_loading: Active skin's spinner folder. User /etc/enigma2/spinner retains precedence.

causality: Automatic acceleration of the original background buffers is a concrete, source-backed hypothesis. Without the receiver framebuffer/driver trace this is not a proven root cause or proof that all fragmentation is fixed.
rollout: Isolated receiver-test prerelease; no production/test updater feed activation.
